text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the official Iraqi press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Uday Saddam Hussein receives an envoy from the Russian Democratic Liberal party who wishes him good health.
- Hundreds of Turkish trucks loaded with foodstuffs and goods arrive at the Iraqi-Turkish border point of Khabour.
- Turkish energy minister says the volume of trade exchange between Iraq and Turkey will increase.
- Spain decides to reopen its embassy in Baghdad.
(The above stories were also carried by JUMHOURIYA and THAWRA)
- Yemen expresses readiness to bring food and medicine to Iraq under the oil-for-food deal signed by Baghdad and the U.N.
- President Saddam Hussein chairs a cabinet meeting which calls for facilitating the movement of vehicles and trucks between the Kurdish autonomy areas and the rest of the country.
